cs.t: I've been using another similar system called AndroidAPS for three years now. With Dexcom G6 and DanaRS pump it means I never need to measure my glucose from my fingertips, be afraid of hypos and wake up every morning with a 5.5 mmol/l glucose. My A1c has been 6.0% the whole time and all I need is a bluetooth capable Android phone. A night and day difference to the hell I was living with my T1 before I found this system...
cs.th: Open-source automated insulin delivery system given approval by team of experts
